units.source_text: 我觉得无法理解，但我并不是为了研究先生出入他家的，所以我也没有再强求。

en.t: I thought it was impossible to understand, but I was not going in and out of Sensei's house in order to study him, so I did not press the matter further.

units.source_text: 现在看来，我当时采取的态度，算得上是我人生中很可贵的品格之一。

en.t: Looking back now, the attitude I took then may be counted as one of the precious qualities of my life.

units.source_text: 我想正因为如此，我才得以和先生保持这样一种充满人情味的交往。

en.t: I think it was precisely because of that that I was able to maintain such a warmly human relationship with Sensei.

units.source_text: 倘若我出于好奇心，哪怕是一点点，想去探究先生内心的话，

en.t: If, out of curiosity, even in the slightest degree, I had tried to probe Sensei's heart,

units.source_text: 那么连接在我们之间的那条同情的线，那时就可能会立刻断掉。

en.t: then the thread of sympathy that connected us might have snapped at once.

units.source_text: 我很年轻，并没有意识到自己的这种态度，也许因此才是可贵的。

en.t: I was young and was not aware of this attitude of mine; perhaps that is why it was precious.

units.source_text: 如果我误入禁区的话，还不知我们的关系会受到怎样的影响呢。

en.t: If I had wandered by mistake into forbidden ground, who knows what effect it would have had on our relationship.

units.source_text: 想一想都觉得后怕，因为即便不这样，先生都在惧怕别人用冷静的眼光研究他。

en.t: Even thinking about it frightens me, because even without that, Sensei was afraid of being studied by others with a cool, detached eye.

units.source_text: 每月我都要去先生家叨扰两三次。

en.t: Every month I would impose on Sensei at his house two or three times.

units.source_text: 日渐频繁后，一天，先生突然问我：

en.t: After my visits gradually became more frequent, one day Sensei suddenly asked me:

units.source_text: “你为什么三天两头地到我这样的人家里来呢？”

en.t: "Why do you come so often to the house of someone like me?"

units.source_text: “要说为什么，也没什么特别的原因。

en.t: "If you ask why, there is no particular reason.
-- Only, I am bothering you, aren't I?"

units.source_text: 先生确实没有流露出厌烦的样子。

en.t: Sensei certainly showed no sign of annoyance.

units.source_text: 我知道先生交际面很窄，

en.t: I knew that Sensei's social circle was very narrow,

units.source_text: 还知道先生住在东京的老同学，那时只不过两三个人。

en.t: and I also knew that among Sensei's old classmates, only two or three were living in Tokyo at the time.

units.source_text: 虽说先生偶尔也和同乡出身的老同学在客厅聊天，

en.t: Although Sensei would occasionally chat in the sitting room with old classmates from his home province,

units.source_text: 但是他们给我的感觉，都不如我跟先生那么亲近。

en.t: they all seemed to me less close to Sensei than I was.
